verdict.rationale: Meltano documents official SDKs: the SDK for Singer Connectors and the EDK for Meltano Components, used to build your own connectors. An independent community user reports the SDK experience was "absolutely top class" when building a custom tap. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation in the evidence (language coverage, API surface, versioning), and any official SDK or API client for controlling Meltano itself programmatically (the OpenAPI probes returned 404).
